description: Eight sample and hold circuits, each catching the voltage at its input when its trigger rises

inputs.text: The voltage sampled on that row; with nothing patched it takes the In of the nearest row above that has one, and with none patched at all the row samples a fresh random voltage between -5V and 5V
A rising edge samples that row's input; with nothing patched it takes the Trigger of the nearest row above that has one

outputs.text: The voltage held since that row's last trigger

notes: every row works polyphonically and holds each channel separately
